canonical_project: RackBank AI Datacenter Park (Raipur CEN1, Nava Raipur/Atal Nagar)
notes: India's first AI datacenter park (13.5-acre, Rs 1,000 crore, incl. 2.7-ha AI SEZ), 13.5-acre campus at Atal Nagar-Nava Raipur (Raipur district). Phase 1 80 MW inaugurated by CM May 2025; four phases scale to 160 MW by Phase 4; designed for 100,000 GPUs with liquid cooling. capacity_mw=160 = planned full build-out; Phase 1 80 MW launched.
